MR. JUSTICE E.S.INDIRESH  ORAL JUDGMENT 1.
Heard learned counsel appearing for the parties.

2. This appeal is preferred by the claimant seeking enhancement of compensation assailing the judgment and award dated 01.10.2021 in MVC No.1007/2019 on the file of Principal Senior Civil Judge and CJM, Kalaburagi.
NC: 2026:KHC-K:1050 HC-KAR 3.

Having taken note of the submissions made by the learned counsel appearing for the parties and on perusal of the finding recorded by the Tribunal, it is not in dispute that the claimant sustained grievous injury on account of the accident occurred on 26.04.2019.

Hence, the claimant is entitled Mamata vs Mr. Md. Sadiq Darvesh And Anr on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17557811/
2 for compensation.

sentences.text: 4. Having taken note of the Judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of HITESH NAGJIBHAI PATEL Vs. BABABHAI NAGJIBHAI RABARI & ANOTHER reported in 2025 LiveLaw (SC) 871, the re-assessment of compensation towards loss of future earning has to be calculated.

entities.text: HITESH NAGJIBHAI PATEL Vs. BABABHAI NAGJIBHAI RABARI & ANOTHER reported in 2025 LiveLaw (SC) 871
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, since the accident is of the year 2019, the monthly earning of the claimant is taken at Rs.13,250/- as per the guidelines of the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority.

As the claimant has sustained compound depressed fracture of skull with extradural haemotoma as per the wound certificate at Ex.P6, the disability of the claimant is taken at 30% and applying the multiplier of 18,
the claimant is entitled for Rs.8,58,600/- (13250 x 18 x 30% x 12) towards loss of future earning.
NC: 2026:KHC-K:1050 HC-KAR 5.
In the backdrop of the observation made as above, the award of compensation is re
- assessed as follows:

Heads Amount  (in Rupees)
Pain and suffering 1,00,000.00
Loss of amenities 1,00,000.00
Loss of future earnings 8,58,600.00
Towards diet and conveyance 40,000.00 charges
Medical expenses 62,452.00 Total 11,61,052.00 6.

In the result, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) The Miscellaneous First Appeal is allowed in part.

(ii) The claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.11,61,052/- (as against Rs.1,90,000/- awarded by the NC: 2026:KHC-K:1050 HC-KAR Tribunal), with interest at 6% per annum from the date of claim petition till realization.

(iii) In all other aspects, the Judgment and Award passed by the Tribunal shall Mamata vs Mr. Md. Sadiq Darvesh And Anr on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17557811/
3 remain unaltered.
